title: Start the Year-End Shard With the Canonical Header
teaser: New batches must not drift back to the legacy schema.
full_text: Verify the December shard starts with the exact canonical header and every row carries an explicit locale value.

title: Exercise the PDF Parser With a Blank Page
teaser: A blank or decorative-only page should not break document parsing.
full_text: Insert a controlled blank page into a multi-page report and verify the parser opens the file and preserves all remaining text.

title: Refresh Cache Identity When Entitlement Changes
teaser: Free and PRO outputs must not share an ambiguous cache key.
full_text: Change entitlement and verify protected calculation cache entries are regenerated under the new authorization context.

title: Keep Personal Data Out of Backup File Names
teaser: A filename alone can leak unnecessary user information.
full_text: Create a backup and verify profile names birth dates and client labels are not embedded in the archive name.

title: Reject February Twenty-Nine in a Non-Leap Year
teaser: The date parser must not silently normalize an impossible calendar day.
full_text: Submit 2035-02-29 and verify it fails with an explicit validation error.

title: Stop Invalid Coordinates Before Calculation
teaser: Out-of-range latitude or longitude should never reach the astronomy provider.
full_text: Submit invalid coordinates and verify validation rejects them before any provider call occurs.

title: Move Assistive Focus to the First Invalid Field
teaser: A visible error is insufficient when semantic focus stays elsewhere.
full_text: Submit an invalid form and verify the first failing field receives focus with an accessible error description.

title: Verify Backup Manifest Integrity Before Restore
teaser: An altered manifest invalidates the package even when data files appear intact.
full_text: Change one byte in the manifest and verify integrity validation rejects the archive before restore begins.

title: Persist Planetary-Hour Provider Provenance
teaser: The same date should remain explainable when astronomy providers evolve.
full_text: Verify a daily snapshot stores the astronomy provider identity and version used for planetary-hour calculation.

title: Keep Numeric Meaning Identical Across TR and EN
teaser: Decimal formatting belongs to presentation rather than calculation.
full_text: Render one result in both locales and verify the underlying numeric value remains exactly the same.

title: Run the Release Build Without Optional Analytics
teaser: Core app behavior must not depend on a nonessential telemetry endpoint.
full_text: Make telemetry unreachable and verify required offline functionality continues normally.

title: Keep the PDF Creation Timestamp Immutable
teaser: A saved report should not acquire a new creation time each time it is opened.
full_text: Save a report reopen it and verify its created-at metadata remains unchanged.

title: Preserve Timezone Identity in the BaZi Hour Input
teaser: The same wall-clock time can represent different moments in different zones.
full_text: Use an hour-pillar fixture and verify the IANA timezone identity is part of the calculation input.

title: Do Not Reopen Undo After Its Window Expires
teaser: A stale callback must not restore data after the undo period has ended.
full_text: Let a delete undo window expire then invoke a delayed callback and verify the record stays deleted.

title: Fail Hard When a Manifest Asset Is Missing
teaser: A missing required asset is not a valid release with a silent placeholder.
full_text: Remove one expected file and verify the release asset gate stops with an explicit failure.

title: Neutralize Spreadsheet Formula Injection in CSV
teaser: User text beginning with a formula prefix can be interpreted as executable spreadsheet content.
full_text: Export a dangerous-prefix field and verify the canonical escaping policy is applied.

title: Read Master Number Policy From One Source
teaser: Rules for 11 22 and 33 must not diverge across surfaces.
full_text: Run the same fixture through calculation and PDF projection layers and compare the reduction-policy result.

title: Remove Deleted Profiles From Search Indexes
teaser: Deleted primary data should not survive in local discovery surfaces.
full_text: Delete one profile and verify it disappears from local search indexes and recent-item lists.

title: Test Exact House-Cusp Assignment
teaser: Planets on a cusp need a stable documented house-assignment policy.
full_text: Verify fixtures immediately before exactly on and immediately after a cusp against the contracted house rule.

title: Announce PRO Lock Context to Screen Readers
teaser: A lock icon alone does not communicate accessible meaning.
full_text: Verify a PRO-only card exposes lock state and upgrade context in its accessible label.

title: Recover an Interrupted Restore Transaction Safely
teaser: An app termination during restore must not leave permanent partial data.
full_text: Terminate the process mid-restore and verify restart follows the documented transaction recovery policy.

title: Golden-Test Solar Events Near the Winter Solstice
teaser: Seasonal extremes can magnify solar-event calculation errors.
full_text: Use an independently prepared winter-solstice fixture and verify sunrise and sunset remain within tolerance.

title: Reject Deep-Link Parameters Outside the Schema
teaser: Unexpected route parameters must not be accepted as harmless defaults.
full_text: Invoke a deep link with an undefined field and verify the parser rejects the extra parameter.

title: Catch Layout Overflow With Long Client Names
teaser: Real Unicode names can exceed the short strings used in ordinary fixtures.
full_text: Render a long Unicode name in profile header and PDF cover layouts and verify neither overflows.

title: Complete Backup and Restore Fully Offline
teaser: Local backup should not require internet access.
full_text: In airplane mode create a backup restore it and verify all expected tables return with matching hashes.

title: Keep PDF Page Growth Consistent With Added Content
teaser: Adding sections should not unexpectedly produce fewer pages.
full_text: Add controlled content to the same report and verify pagination remains internally consistent.

title: Retain Timezone-Database Provenance for Old Snapshots
teaser: A tzdb update must not silently rewrite the meaning of historical results.
full_text: Verify persisted snapshots store the timezone database version used as provenance.

title: Compare December Date Sets Across TR and EN
teaser: Equal totals do not guarantee exact per-day locale parity.
full_text: Compare both December 2034 shard date-key sets and verify the difference set is empty.

title: Run Near-Duplicate Review on the December Batch
teaser: Different titles can still hide substantially repeated body text.
full_text: Scan new December title teaser and full_text fields against the near-duplicate threshold and inspect any candidates.

title: Recompute the Year-End Ledger From Physical Shards
teaser: Committed files should remain the source of truth rather than a handwritten counter.
full_text: Scan shards from 2026-01-01 and derive the contiguous end date and per-locale totals again.

title: Close 2034 With an Exact 2035 Continuation Boundary
teaser: Year rollover must not introduce ambiguity into editorial progress.
full_text: Verify both December shards and record 2035-01-01 as the next exact editorial start date.
